script.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Calling the cherubim angels adds an identification the passage does not make.
The joke about keeping a stamp lined up in a junk drawer does not make clear sense as a comparison to the craftsmen’s work.
Saying the baker showed confidence assumes something about the baker that their answer does not establish.
The text says the cherubim look toward the mercy seat, not that their eyes are on the same spot.
